title: Validate scoring stack on a managed cloud Kubernetes cluster
description: Local kind validates Gateway API behavior, chart correctness, and the scoring path, but cannot validate cloud LoadBalancer provisioning, real TLS, registry pulls, or amd64 nodes. Stand up a small short-lived managed Kubernetes cluster on the provider matching the production target, deploy the stack with registry-published amd64 images, and run the end-to-end scoring request through the provisioned load balancer. Pending decision on subscription/account to use; depends on the amd64 image build chore. Tear the cluster down after validation to control cost.
